disposition_reason: The paper reports an ordered Allen test-NLL result, but the split, metric normalization and model flags needed to reproduce that number disagree with the available code path. The local equal-session interaction-gain endpoint is prospective and cannot substitute for exceeding the published full-model task.

source_paper.title: Identifying interactions across brain areas while accounting for individual-neuron dynamics with a Transformer-based variational autoencoder

evidence.locator: Section 3 Training; Section 4.5; Appendix A Table S1; Appendix G
evidence.supports: Source task, Allen cohort, trial preprocessing, posterior-mean inference and published full-model test NLL.
Code defaults train=.7, val=.1, remainder test, with condition-dependent integer allocations, unlike paper train/test/validation=.7/.1/.2.
Released loss averages Poisson terms and adds scaled KL; this does not directly identify Table S1 total test NLL.
Validation loss selects checkpoint; predict uses posterior means and defaults self-history/coupling off, so exact evaluation flags and batch membership matter.

target.description: Estimate held-out-trial spike-count intensity with the full GLM-Transformer and compare its reconstruction NLL to source ablations. Posterior inference sees target-population activity; this is not blind forecasting or proof of causal coupling.

dataset.description: Allen Institute Visual Coding Neuropixels data used by the authors; six visual areas, all available trial types, 121,679 400-ms trials reported. Exact retrieved recording content remains unbound.

cohort.description: All ten source sessions: 757216464, 798911424, 715093703, 719161530, 721123822, 737581020, 739448407, 742951821, 743475441, 744228101. Do not omit sessions or anatomical groups to obtain a lower loss.

split.description: Paper says training/test/validation 70/10/20%; pinned loader uses training/validation/test 70/10/remainder with special 15-trial allocations. Original Table S1 memberships, seed/state, eligibility and native inference batches must be recovered before a same-task score.

inputs.description: Source neural spike trains and within-trial self/cross-population history with target-conditioned latent inference; preserve posterior-mean test inference and the same source conditioning. Removing target conditioning changes the task.

preprocessing.description: Source uses 2-ms bins and 400-ms trials: concatenate short contiguous presentations, truncate longer discrete trials and segment long stimuli without overlap. Exact neuron QC, invalid-time exclusion, padding, source/code axis layout and historical artifact identities are not reconciled.

metric.description: Table S1 names test negative log likelihood. Poisson NLL is sum(exp(eta)-y*eta+log(y!)); pinned loss_function instead averages the first two terms and adds beta times KL. Recover the exact total, constant, KL and model-flag convention that produced 4.218e7.

aggregation.description: Paper Table S1 gives total-scale test NLL and SE; native trainer trial-weights batch mean variational loss. The local evaluator’s equal-session mean interaction gain has different units and weighting. Historical aggregation and replicate units remain unresolved.

comparison.primary_metric: Allen Visual Coding Table S1 full-model test negative log likelihood

published_baseline.description: Table S1: full GLM-Transformer Allen test NLL 4.218 × 10^7, SE 3.8 × 10^4. This number is verified as reported; comparability to the released evaluation route is unresolved.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: No same-task author rerun. The released loss and split require scientific version reconciliation; a local history-versus-interaction gain is not this baseline.

minimum_effect.rationale: No meaningful NLL gain can be specified until the scored observations, normalization and baseline uncertainty are recovered.

uncertainty.method: Recover the authors’ Table S1 replicate definition first; then predeclare paired uncertainty preserving whole-animal/session and within-session trial dependence with matched training-seed replication. No alpha or margin is invented.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Animal/session for biological replication, with trials clustered and shared-model training dependence accounted for.
uncertainty.rationale: Neither individual spikes nor bins are independent replicates; the paper SE does not identify an executable uncertainty design by itself.

paper_win_requires: Reconcile the exact Table S1 dataset, split, preprocessing, model flags, posterior inference and total-NLL reduction before any active improvement episode.
Beat the full GLM-Transformer source result and its calibrated author rerun; increasing a local history-to-interaction difference does not establish that result.
Retain all ten sessions and the same available inputs; a new split or different target-conditioning rule is an extension.
Require predeclared meaningful effect and valid uncertainty; causal-interaction claims require separate evidence.

current_sota.description: The source-paper comparison is distinct from current SOTA; no current-SOTA search or claim is admitted by this contract.

episode.improvement_loop: No active improvement episode until paper/code metric and split identities are recovered; then use only source training/validation feedback for iteration.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze model, source data/axes, trial memberships, inference batches, conditioning flags, normalization and original author baseline before final scoring.
episode.final_evaluation: Evaluate the complete original Table S1 held-out observations using its recovered score convention; local prospective gains remain separately labeled.
episode.baseline_policy: The source full-model Table S1 score is the comparator. Reproduction of paper components, ablation reconstruction or generated engineering controls is calibration only. Where the source protocol itself uses stochastic draws, a faithful rerun may use declared provenance, a justified reproduction tolerance and paired candidate-author draws; fixed source partitions and full original condition support must remain unchanged.

blocking_issues: Paper/code validation-test split naming and original memberships are unresolved.
Table S1 total NLL versus released mean variational loss, omitted Poisson constant and replicate definition are unresolved.
Native notebook/trainer flags and interface, target-conditioned encoder layout and inference batches require reconciliation.
No authenticated complete Allen preprocessing/reference run, fixed budgets, justified improvement effect or final uncertainty rule.

legacy.notes: Retain initial-evaluator-v1 unchanged. Its equal-session interaction gain, altered history flags and generated controls are prospective/calibration components; they cannot be compared numerically with Table S1 full-model NLL or called blind prediction.
